byte_identical_to_gated_upstream.verified: The Hugging Face content-addressed identifiers agree: the four weight shards have the same LFS sha256 in both repositories, and config.json, generation_config.json, model.safetensors.index.json, special_tokens_map.json and tokenizer.json have the same git blob ids.  Only tokenizer_config.json (chat template metadata, unused by the capture) differs.  The pinned per-file sha256 below were recomputed from the downloaded snapshot and equal those LFS digests.

tokenizer.identity_anchor: input_token_sha256: SHA256 of exact saved input_ids as signed int32 little-endian bytes
tokenizer.prefix_token: HF encode(add_special_tokens=True); never manually prepend or pad tokens
tokenizer.source: pinned tokenizer.json/tokenizer_config.json/special_tokens_map.json/config.json, each verified against prompt manifest and model file SHA

quality_policy: calibrate on author-pilot and freeze before independent holdout; no default calibrated margin
scope: four task subset, one model; finite sample quality decision and kernel throughput measured separately

terminal_quality.visibility: private Judge only; interactive/public never uses this set
terminal_quality.freeze_order: pilot selects candidate and margins; freeze policy before first terminal predictions; do not retune against terminal results
